card.line: Ararat is a mountain region where Noah's ark came to rest after the Flood, and later a land God named when He called nations against Babylon.

moments.title: The ark comes to rest
moments.text: The waters went down for 150 days. On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

moments.title: Nations called against Babylon
moments.text: God's word names Ararat, with Minni and Ashkenaz, among the kingdoms to be summoned against Babylon. The LORD's plan was to make Babylon's land a desolation.
